newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks slightly lower in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks slightly lower in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened slightly lower on Tuesday, despite the yen's recovery against the dollar and Wall Street's record climb overnight.
Dealers said worries about Japan's economy in the near term were still lingering in the market.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 average was down 57.50 points or 0.30 percent at 19,388.50 in the first 10 minutes of trading. Its March futures were 70 points lower at 19,420.
